question.text: The negation of the Boolean expression $((\sim q)$ $\wedge p) \Rightarrow((\sim p) \vee q)$ is logically equivalent to

solution.text:
Given boolen expression are
$\begin{aligned}
& \sim p \vee q \equiv p \rightarrow q \text { and } \sim q \wedge p \equiv \sim(p \rightarrow q) \\
& \text { Negation of } \sim(p \rightarrow q) \rightarrow(p \rightarrow q) \\
& \text { is } \sim(p \rightarrow q) \wedge(\sim(p \rightarrow q)) \text { i.e., } \sim(p \rightarrow q)
\end{aligned}$
